description: Machine-tools; bending, folding, straightening or flattening machines (including presses), for working metal, numerically controlled bending, folding, straightening or fattening machines (not press brakes, panel benders or roll forming machines)

predecessors.note: Before 2022 other numerically controlled bending machines were reported inside HS 846221. The continuous long series is at HS-4 8462.

lineage.familyNote: These codes together cover this product across the HS 2022 revision. They do not overlap in time, so stacking them gives a continuous series without apportioning anything.
